titel: Creditworthiness, SCHUFA and keeping your finances in order
kurz: How contracts and payment behaviour turn into a score, what a weak score costs in interest, and which precautions keep your finances working even in an emergency.

bloecke.md: Every contract in which one side performs first is a form of credit. Examples are the flat before the first rent payment, the mobile phone contract with a subsidised handset, buying on invoice, leasing and the instalment loan. The side that performs first wants to know how likely it is to get its money back. To find out, it asks a credit reference agency, not the person concerned. [[Creditworthiness]] is therefore not a judgement of character. It determines the terms you are offered, even though you usually do not know your own score.

## What a credit reference agency holds

A credit reference agency collects data on contract and payment behaviour. This includes which accounts, cards, loans, leases and mobile phone contracts exist and how long they have been running, whether instalments are paid on time, and whether there are reminder procedures, debt collection, court orders or insolvency entries. Income, wealth, occupation, nationality and religious affiliation are not stored.

A poor score is therefore almost always the result of contracts and late payments, not of poverty. A high salary does not improve it either, because salary does not appear in this data. Salary only plays a role when the bank asks for it in its own application and factors it into its internal rating.

SCHUFA is the best-known credit reference agency, but not the only one. Others include Creditreform Boniversum, CRIF and Infoscore. Mail-order retailers, energy suppliers and landlords often make enquiries with these agencies rather than with SCHUFA. An incorrect entry may therefore be sitting in a database you have never checked.

The first misconception is: “I earn well, so my creditworthiness is good.” But income is not a stored characteristic and can never make up for a weak score.

The second misconception is: “I'll tidy up and close old accounts and cards.” In the current scoring model, the age of the oldest bank relationship counts as a positive characteristic, and the data of a closed account is deleted immediately. Anyone who closes a twenty-year-old current account and opens a new one instead worsens the very figure they wanted to improve.

## How the score is calculated

A [[credit score]] describes a comparison group, not an individual person. It indicates how many out of a hundred people with a similar data pattern have met their obligations as agreed in the past. SCHUFA switched its model in 2026. The new scale runs from 100 to 999 points and replaces the former percentage-based basic score. Around a dozen characteristics have been disclosed. In addition, there are sector scores, under which the same person has a different score with a bank than with a mail-order retailer, because the risk is different in each case.

In December 2023, the European Court of Justice ruled that the calculation of such a score can in itself be an automated decision within the meaning of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) if the contracting party relies on it decisively. Rejected applicants can therefore demand a comprehensible explanation and a review by a human being. They do not have to accept the answer “the system says no”.

bloecke.titel: Data flow through the credit reference agency
bloecke.unter: The credit reference agency sits between the bodies that report data and those that query it; you deal with each side separately, and your only direct access to the stored data is your right of access.

## Interest costs with weak creditworthiness

A weak score rarely leads to a rejection; usually it leads to a higher interest rate. In August 2026, the instalment loans listed on a large comparison website ranged between around 4% and 9% effective annual interest, depending on creditworthiness. The median of the contracts actually concluded was about 6.2%. The following calculation shows the same financing at three different interest rates, and therefore what sums are at stake with creditworthiness.

bloecke.titel: Conditions enquiry instead of credit enquiry
bloecke.md: A **credit conditions enquiry** (Anfrage Kreditkonditionen) has no effect on your score and can be made as often as you like. A **credit enquiry** (Anfrage Kredit), by contrast, is stored as a characteristic and can weigh on your score. This applies especially when several such enquiries arrive in quick succession, because that gives the impression that someone is looking for the last bank still willing to say yes. Before any comparison, you should therefore check which type of enquiry the website transmits. This check costs nothing.

## Deletion periods

Entries are deleted after fixed periods, and these periods are shorter than many people assume. However, they only begin when a claim has been settled, not when it arose. No period is therefore running yet for an outstanding item, and the expectation that it will “become time-barred on its own” is mistaken.

bloecke.unter: Figures in months; current accounts are deleted immediately on closure, and the period for the discharge of residual debt (Restschuldbefreiung) was shortened to six months following case law of the European Court of Justice.

bloecke.md:
## Requesting your own data every year

Looking at your own data once a year takes half an hour. It is the only way to find errors before they come to light, for example when you apply for a flat. The most common findings are settled claims without a settlement note and contracts reported twice after a change of provider. Rarer, but expensive, are contracts that someone else has concluded in your name.

schritte.titel: Request a copy of your data
schritte.text: The copy of your data is free of charge under Article 15(3) GDPR and must be requested from each credit reference agency separately. It contains the complete data record, not just the score.
Look out for unknown contracts, old addresses, outstanding claims without a settlement note and duplicate entries. Note down every irregularity with the date.

Apply to the credit reference agency for rectification under Article 16 GDPR in writing and with evidence, and at the same time to the creditor who reported the entry. Disputed claims must be marked as disputed or deleted.

If there is no response, lodge a complaint with the competent data protection supervisory authority, which is free of charge and requires no particular form. For contracts that a stranger has concluded in your name, also report the identity misuse to the police, because otherwise the creditor will keep sending reminders.

For landlords there is the fee-based credit report (Bonitätsauskunft, in the order of thirty euros), which shows only the score and payment defaults. You should not submit the copy of your data, because it discloses your entire contract history.

bloecke.md:
## Questions when looking for a flat

In tight housing markets, landlords use creditworthiness to choose between applicants, not to set a price. Rejected applicants never find out why. Questions that are necessary for performing the contract are permitted. Impermissible questions do not have to be answered truthfully, and a false answer to them does not later give grounds for terminating the tenancy.

punkte: Net income, employer, type and duration of employment
Credit report from a credit reference agency (score and payment defaults)
Question about ongoing insolvency or eviction proceedings
Certificate of no rent arrears (Mietschuldenfreiheitsbescheinigung), although the previous landlord is not obliged to issue one
Pregnancy, wish for children, family planning
Religion, political party, trade union, ethnic origin
Illnesses and disabilities unrelated to the flat
Criminal records unrelated to the tenancy
Complete account statements for recent months, because they reveal all your spending behaviour

bloecke.md:
## Preparing for emergencies

Creditworthiness is the part of keeping your finances in order that others can see. The other part is the question of whether your finances still work when you cannot act yourself, for example in hospital, after an accident, after a death or when strangers have taken over one of your logins. Debt counselling statistics suggest that such a situation can arise suddenly. In 2025, illness, addiction and accidents were the most common trigger of over-indebtedness at around 18%, ahead of unemployment at just under 17%.

Reference to the password manager and its master password

bloecke.md: The emergency right of representation between spouses (Ehegattennotvertretungsrecht) under Section 1358 BGB (Civil Code) applies only to health matters and for at most six months. It does not cover the bank, the securities account or other contracts. Without a power of attorney, the account remains blocked until the court appoints a legal guardian (Betreuer) or a certificate of inheritance (Erbschein) is issued. Both take weeks to months, while rent and instalments continue. An account power of attorney that is granted on the bank's form and expressly applies **beyond death** closes this gap for payments. It governs only the authority to dispose of the money, not who ultimately owns it. The inheritance law side is covered in the lesson on partnership, children and inheritance.

- Returned direct debits cost fees and are noticed by the creditor. A buffer of one monthly instalment in your current account is cheaper than any reminder stage.
- Within eight weeks, you can reclaim a paid SEPA direct debit without giving a reason (Section 675x BGB). For debits that were never authorised, a notification period of thirteen months applies (Section 676b BGB). After that, the claim lapses.
- Have a lost card blocked immediately. For unauthorised payments before the block, you are generally liable only up to €50 (Section 675v BGB), but without limit in the case of gross negligence.
- Go through standing orders, direct debit mandates and subscriptions once a year, ideally together with the data request.

bloecke.titel: Protecting your securities account against fraud
bloecke.md:
A securities account cannot be stolen like a card, but it can be emptied just like a bank account. Four rules help against this.

- Use a separate email address for your bank and broker that you use nowhere else. Use each password only once and manage them in a password manager.
- If possible, keep two-factor authentication off the device on which the broker app runs. SMS TAN is the weakest method, because a hijacked mobile number is all it takes.
- Never give an authorisation at the request of third parties. Neither the bank nor the broker nor the police will ever ask for a TAN, a push confirmation or a remote maintenance session. Every authorisation contains a text that you should read before confirming.
- Keep securities account statements and tax certificates. Without records of the acquisition data, a securities account transfer creates a tax problem. That is not a security problem, but it can become expensive.

bloecke.titel: Basic payment account and garnishment protection account
bloecke.md:
Even with a negative entry, you are entitled to a [[basic payment account (Basiskonto)]]. Under Section 31 ZKG (Payment Accounts Act), every bank that offers payment accounts to consumers must provide an account with basic functions, regardless of creditworthiness and credit reference agency records. The bank must give reasons for a rejection, and BaFin (Federal Financial Supervisory Authority) has a dedicated procedure for this.

If an account is garnished, the garnishment protection account (Pfändungsschutzkonto, P-Konto) protects a basic monthly exempt amount. It is adjusted every year on 1 July and increases if you have maintenance obligations. There is a legal right to have your existing current account converted into a P-Konto. The bank must do this within four business days, and the protection applies retroactively from the start of the current month.

mitnehmen: A credit reference agency stores contracts and payment behaviour, but neither income nor wealth, so its score depends on behaviour, not on prosperity.
For €15,000 over five years, around €2,000 in interest separates the best and the weakest listed terms; that is how much a weak score can cost.
Three measures cost nothing: making conditions enquiries instead of credit enquiries, keeping your oldest account and checking the free copy of your data once a year.
Give landlords the fee-based credit report, not the complete copy of your data with your entire contract history.
Keeping your finances in order includes a power of attorney beyond death at the bank, an emergency folder without passwords, separate logins and no authorisations at the request of third parties.

begriffe.text: Assessment of the probability that someone will meet their payment obligations as agreed. Credit reference agencies such as SCHUFA assess payment and contract behaviour for this purpose, not income or wealth.

Numerical value from a credit reference agency that assigns a person to a statistical comparison group and reflects that group's historical default rate. It says nothing about the individual case. Since 2026, the new SCHUFA scale has run from 100 to 999.
Enquiry for a non-binding offer, transmitted as “Anfrage Kreditkonditionen”. Unlike the “Anfrage Kredit”, it is not passed on to other contracting parties and does not weigh on the score.
Free, complete disclosure of all data stored about a person under Article 15(3) GDPR. It is intended for your own checks, not for submission to landlords.

begriffe.begriff: Transmortal account power of attorney (transmortale Kontovollmacht)
begriffe.text: Account power of attorney that expressly applies beyond death and allows access to payments without a certificate of inheritance. It governs the authority to dispose, not ownership.
Payment account with basic functions to which every consumer is entitled under Section 31 ZKG, regardless of creditworthiness and negative entries.
